newsitem.title: POLAND: NKT Cables calls public tender for Kable.
newsitem.headline: NKT Cables calls public tender for Kable.

text.p: Denmark's NKT Cables announced a public tender offer to buy one million shares in Polish cablemaker Kable SA at 41 zlotys per share, the Warsaw bourse said in a statement on Monday.
NKT Cables last month upped its Kable stake to 50 percent, or one million shares, by buying 500,000 shares from Denmark's Investment Fund for Central and Eastern Europe.
Late in February NKT Cables called two public tender offers at 27.9 zlotys each for the 1.5 million outstanding shares, or 75 percent of Kable, which it did not own.
But only the Danish fund, which earlier held 500,000 shares, sold its shares in the offer priced lower than the market.
Kable shares closed on the Warsaw bourse at 41 zlotys on Monday.
The statement said ING Barings Securities (Poland) would be taking offers from Kable shareholders between April 8 and May 19.
The bourse said that because of the tender offer announcement, Kable shares would not trade on Tuesday, April 8.
